pattern.description: The finished chat demo pushes in and drifts off to the right while fading, and a single 'Transcription' feature tile (mic-on-document icon) scales up from a tiny glyph at centre on an empty canvas, starting the feature-list section.
pattern.why_premium: The outgoing UI and incoming tile overlap in one continuous scale move, so the topic change (demo -> capability list) needs no cut; the stark single tile on whitespace resets attention right on the narration word 'Building'.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.chat', {scale: 1.2, x: '+=260', opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.in'}); tl.fromTo('.tile', {scale: 0.15, opacity: 0}, {scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}, '-=0.2'); tile label inherits the tile transform.
build_hint.remotion: Chat: interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [1, 1.2]) scale + translateX and opacity 1->0 with Easing.in(Easing.cubic). Tile: spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 160}) driving scale 0.15->1 and opacity, starting ~9 frames in.

notes: Camera verdict push_in (scale 1.20, pan_x 0.20) describes the outgoing chat; the incoming tile scales independently, so this reads as a transition rather than a pure camera move.
